Stellan Smith-Rel — Speaker+Hub Datasheet Multi-Play Cat Toy Super Awesome Products Inc. (Team 203)

Submission Date: October 26, 2026

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: This datasheet documents Stellan Smith-Rel's individual contributions to the EGR 304 Team 203 project. It provides an overview of the project, outlines my responsibilities, and links to the supporting engineering documentation.

docs.title: Project Summary
docs.text:
Our team is developing a customizable cat toy that integrates multiple interactive components, including a motor, speaker, microphone, and pressure sensor. These components work together to provide a flexible and engaging play experience for cats.

For additional details about the project, please refer to our team report.

docs.title: My Contribution
docs.text:
My primary contribution is the design and development of the system's central control board, which serves as the primary interface for communication between the toy's various subsystems. This board is responsible for receiving and transmitting signals to other boards, as well as controlling the speaker component.

The following sections provide further documentation of the system design and implementation:

  • Block Diagram
  • Component Selection
  • Schematic
  • Power Budget

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This block diagram goes over how the central hub of the EGR 304 Team 203 combined PCB will operate. The circuit will only require 5V power, as shown by the 5V Voltage Regulator. The primary function will be receiving data and issuing commands to the various peripherals attached via the connectors. Each connector will have pin 4 be outgoing, and pin 3 be inbound, which are wired to various digital pins on the microcontroller. Pin 8 will be reserved for a common ground. Additionally, the circuit will include a on-board speaker, which will be connected to an AB Amp, which then will be connected to the microcontroller by an analog pin. For testing purposes, a simple button and LED will also be included.

docs.title: Op-Amps
docs.text:
Operational Amplifiers

Solution Image Pros Cons MCP6022-I/P * Two op-amp channels in one package* Higher bandwidth of approximately 10 MHz* Faster slew rate than the MCP6004* Suitable for higher-speed analog signals * Requires a supply voltage of approximately 2.5V to 5.5V* Higher power consumption than the MCP6004* Only two channels per package MCP6004-I/P * Four op-amp channels in one package* Rail-to-rail input and output* Low power consumption* Operates from 1.8V to 6V * Lower bandwidth of 1 MHz* Relatively slow slew rate of 0.6 V/µs* Higher channel count may be unnecessary for simple circuits MCP6244-E/P * Four op-amp channels in one package* Rail-to-rail operation* Extended-temperature option* Suitable for low-voltage circuits * Requires verification of bandwidth and output drive for the application* Extended-temperature rating may be unnecessary* Supply voltage compatibility must be checked

Choice: Option 2: MCP6004-I/P quad operational amplifier

Rationale: The MCP6004-I/P is the preferred choice because it provides four operational amplifier channels in a single package while maintaining low power consumption. Its rail-to-rail input and output capabilities make it suitable for low-voltage analog circuits. Its relatively low bandwidth is appropriate for applications that do not require high-speed signal processing.

docs.title: 5V 1.5 A Voltage Regulator
docs.text:
Voltage Regulators

Solution Image Pros Cons L7805ABV-DG * Fixed 5V output* Simple circuit design* Can supply up to approximately 1.5A under suitable thermal conditions* Widely used through-hole package * Requires adequate input-to-output voltage headroom* Can dissipate substantial heat at high currents* Requires thermal management and appropriate capacitors MCP1827-ADJE/AT * Adjustable output voltage* Rated for 1.5A output current* Low dropout voltage* Low quiescent current* Thermal and short-circuit protection * Maximum input voltage is 6V, so it cannot regulate a 9V input directly* Requires external resistors to set the output voltage* Linear-regulator efficiency decreases with increasing voltage drop TPS75901KCG3 * High current capability, up to 7.5A for the TPS759 family* Low dropout voltage* Enable and power-good features* Adjustable output voltage * Input voltage must remain within the device's specified range, up to 5.5V* Not suitable for direct 9V-to-5V regulation* Higher current capability may be unnecessary for a 1.5A application* Requires careful output-capacitor selection

Choice: Option 1: L7805ABV-DG 5V linear voltage regulator

Rationale: The L7805ABV-DG is the preferred choice because it provides a fixed 5V output and can support the required current under suitable thermal conditions. Its straightforward design simplifies circuit implementation. However, the power dissipated as heat must be considered carefully. With a 9V input and a 5V output at 1.5A, the regulator would dissipate approximately 6W, so appropriate heat sinking is necessary. A switching regulator may be more efficient if the circuit operates near its maximum current for extended periods.

docs.title: Speaker
docs.text:
Audio Output Speaker

Solution Image Pros Cons CMS-28528N-L152 * Compact 28 mm diameter speaker* Nominal 8-ohm impedance* Up to 3W maximum input power* Frequency response extends to approximately 20 kHz* Lightweight construction * Approximately 750 Hz resonant frequency limits low-frequency performance* Requires an amplifier for suitable output volume* Small size limits bass response* Maximum power rating must not be exceeded FR 8 - 8 OHM * 8-ohm nominal impedance* Suitable for applications designed around an 8-ohm speaker* Potentially useful for general audio output * Requires an amplifier compatible with its impedance and power rating* Physical size may limit enclosure options* Exact power handling and sensitivity must be verified CSS-1021028N * Compact speaker option* Potentially suitable for space-constrained designs* Can be evaluated for basic audio or alert output * Exact impedance and power rating must be verified* Small speakers may have limited bass response and maximum volume* Requires a compatible amplifier

Choice: Option 2: FR 8 - 8 OHM speaker

Rationale: The FR 8 - 8 OHM is the preferred choice because its nominal 8-ohm impedance can be compatible with a wide range of audio amplifier circuits designed for 8-ohm loads. Its suitability for the project will depend on its rated power handling, sensitivity, physical dimensions, and frequency response. These specifications should be confirmed before finalizing the circuit and enclosure design.

docs.title: 9V 3A Unregulated Power Supply
docs.text:
DC Power Input Connectors

Note: PJ-102AH, PJ-050AH, and RAPC722X are connector part numbers, not complete power supplies. The comparison below concerns their suitability for connecting an external 9V, 3A supply.

Solution Image Pros Cons PJ-102AH * Through-hole, right-angle barrel jack* 5.5 mm outer diameter and 2.0 mm inner diameter* Rated for up to 5A* Suitable current rating for a 3A supply * Requires a matching 5.5 mm / 2.0 mm plug* Right-angle orientation constrains PCB layout* Rated for 24V DC maximum, not a voltage regulator PJ-050AH * Alternative barrel-jack option* May provide a compact power-input connection* Can be used if its dimensions and ratings match the supply * Exact dimensions and current rating must be verified* Plug compatibility must be confirmed* Must not be assumed to support 3A without datasheet verification RAPC722X * Alternative DC power connector* May offer a suitable panel-mount or chassis connection, depending on its specification* Can simplify external power connections * Exact connector configuration and current rating must be verified* May require additional mounting space* Requires a matching plug and compatible wiring

Choice: Option 1: PJ-102AH DC power connector

Rationale: The PJ-102AH is the preferred choice because its documented current rating of up to 5A exceeds the project's 3A requirement. Its through-hole, right-angle configuration is suitable for PCB mounting. The mating plug must match the connector's dimensions, and the power supply's polarity must be verified before connecting it to the circuit.

docs.title: Batteries
docs.text:
9V Batteries

Solution Image Pros Cons EN22 * Standard 9V battery format* Convenient replacement option* Suitable for low-power electronics and intermittent use* Widely available battery type * Not suitable for sustained 3A loads* High current draw causes significant voltage drop and short runtime* Disposable battery replacement adds recurring cost* Performance depends on load and temperature A1604 BK210J * Standard 9V battery format* Convenient and widely compatible with 9V battery holders* Simple to replace* Suitable for low-current portable applications * Limited capacity at high current draws* Voltage drops as the battery discharges* Not ideal for sustained 3A loads* Battery chemistry and discharge characteristics must be verified 6LF22XWA/B * Standard 9V battery format* Convenient for portable devices* No charging circuitry required if used as a primary battery* Suitable for intermittent, low-current loads * Not suitable for sustained 3A loads* Voltage sag and short runtime at high currents* Capacity depends on discharge rate and battery chemistry* Exact manufacturer specifications should be confirmed

Choice: Option 2: A1604 BK210J 9V battery

Rationale: The A1604 BK210J is the preferred choice because its standard 9V format is convenient to integrate into a portable circuit and easy to replace. It is most appropriate for low-current operation or intermittent loads. If the project requires a sustained current approaching 3A, this battery is not suitable; a higher-capacity rechargeable battery pack designed for the required discharge current should be considered instead.

docs.title: Transistors
docs.text:
Small-Signal Bipolar Junction Transistors

Solution Image Pros Cons 2N3904 * General-purpose NPN transistor suitable for switching and amplification* Collector-emitter voltage rating of 40V* Collector current rating of up to 200mA* Widely available and inexpensive* Suitable for low-power circuit applications * Limited to low-current applications* Requires a base resistor for typical switching applications* Not suitable for directly driving high-current loads 2N3906 * General-purpose PNP transistor suitable for switching and amplification* Complementary counterpart to the 2N3904* Collector-emitter voltage rating of approximately 40V* Useful for high-side switching and complementary amplifier circuits* Widely available and inexpensive * Limited to low-current applications* Requires appropriate base biasing and current limiting* PNP operation may require different control logic than an NPN transistor 2N3904BK * General-purpose NPN transistor suitable for switching and amplification* 40V collector-emitter voltage rating* Common TO-92 through-hole package* Low-cost alternative to other 2N3904 variants* Suitable for low-power circuit applications * Limited to low-current applications* Requires a base resistor for typical switching applications* Electrical characteristics and package pinout should be verified against the selected manufacturer's datasheet

Choice: Options 1 and 2: 2N3904 NPN transistor and 2N3906 PNP transistor

Rationale: The 2N3904 and 2N3906 are the preferred choices because they provide complementary NPN and PNP transistor operation for general-purpose switching and amplification. Using both types allows the circuit to support different switching configurations and complementary analog stages. Their low cost and widespread availability make them practical choices for a student electronics project. The 2N3904BK is a viable alternative NPN transistor, but it offers no fundamental functional advantage over a standard 2N3904 without a specific manufacturer or sourcing requirement.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This schematic is designed to support the hub-spoke operation of a multi-part cat toy, with this being the hub. There are multiple connectors to allow for off-board communication. Additionally, there is a simple speaker circuit that does not require a H-Bridge to operate, and a voltage regulator to supply 5V power to all circuit nets. The Curiosity Nano microcontroller manages all aspects of the circuit.

Figure ##: This is the image of the schematic.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This power budget was a critical step in creating our product. By calculating the current taken by each component, we can determine whether or not we have enough power to ensure proper operations, within a 25% safety margin.

Power Budget can be found below.

docs.title: Conclusions
docs.text: From the prepared Power Budget, it can be determined that a 9V battery is not enough to operate the speaker. Therefore, a wall-based power supply will be needed. This is informative for both our current design, and for potential future iterations on the design.
